children.name: Harperocallis
children.description: Harperocallis — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Harperocallis duidae  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis duidae is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is a perennial or rhizome.

children.name: Harperocallis falcata  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis falcata is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is a rhizome native to Ecuador and Peru.

children.name: Harperocallis flava McDaniel
children.description: Harperocallis flava, known by the common name Harper's beauty, is a species endemic to parts of  Florida in the United States, where it is known mainly from the Apalachicola National Forest in the Panhandle. It is seriously endangered and has been on the United States' endangered species list since 1979.

children.name: Harperocallis longiflora  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis longiflora is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is a rhizomatous plant native to Bolivia.

children.name: Harperocallis neblinae  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis neblinae is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is endemic to, and named after, Cerro de la Neblina, Venezuela.

children.name: Harperocallis paniculata  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis paniculata is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is known only from Serra da Neblina, Brazil.

children.name: Harperocallis penduliflora  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis penduliflora is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. The species is native to the Venezuelan portion of Cerro de la Neblina.

children.name: Harperocallis robustior  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis robustior is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is a rhizomatous plant native to Venezuela.

children.name: Harperocallis schomburgkiana  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis schomburgkiana is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is a rhizomatous plant with white to cream tepals.

children.name: Harperocallis sessiliflora  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis sessiliflora is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is a rhizomatous plant.

children.name: Harperocallis sipapoensis  L.M.Campb. & Dorr
children.description: Harperocallis sipapoensis is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae. It is native to, and named for, Cerro Sipapo, a mountain in Venezuela.

children.name: Triantha
children.description: Triantha — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Triantha glutinosa  Baker
children.description: Triantha glutinosa is a species of flowering plant in the Tofieldiaceae family.

children.name: Triantha japonica  Baker
children.description: Triantha japonica is a species of flowering plant in the genus Triantha.

children.name: Triantha occidentalis  R.R.Gates
children.description: Triantha occidentalis, the western false asphodel, is a species of carnivorous flowering plant in the genus Triantha from the family Tofieldiaceae within the order of the Alismatales.

children.name: Triantha racemosa  Small
children.description: Triantha racemosa, commonly called the coastal false asphodel or southern bog asphodel, is a species of flowering plant in the Tofieldia family.

children.name: Pleea
children.description: Pleea — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Pleea tenuifolia Michx.
children.description: Pleea is a small genus of flowering plants described as a genus in 1803. There is only one known species, Pleea tenuifolia, the rush featherling, native to the southeastern United States (Florida, Alabama, North Carolina, and South Carolina).

children.name: Tofieldia
children.description: Tofieldia — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Tofieldia calyculata  Wahlenb.
children.description: Tofieldia calyculata is a species of flowering plant belonging to the family Tofieldiaceae.

children.name: Tofieldia cernua Sm.
children.description: The native range of this species is Siberia to Russian Far East. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia coccinea Richardson
children.description: The native range of this species is Siberia to Japan, Aleutian Is. to Canada. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia divergens Bureau & Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. China to N. Myanmar. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia furusei  M.N.Tamura & Fuse
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan (SC. & S. Honshu). It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia glabra Nutt.
children.description: Wet pine savannas (SPS-T, SPS-RF, VWLPS).

children.name: Tofieldia himalaica Baker
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & E. Himalaya. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Tofieldia nuda Maxim.
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan (S. Honshu, Kyushu). It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia okuboi Makino
children.description: The native range of this species is Kuril Is. to N. & C. Japan. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia pusilla  Pers.
children.description: Tofieldia pusilla is a species of flowering plant in the family Tofieldiaceae.

children.name: Tofieldia thibetica Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. China to N. Myanmar. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Tofieldia yoshiiana Makino
children.description: The native range of this species is Korea, S. Japan. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
